key_developments: Nate Silver's forecast shows Democrats ahead in nine of 12 competitive Senate races, signaling potential Republican losses of Senate control.
Trump's RNC midterm convention drew poor attendance with major GOP candidates opting out, signaling internal party tensions weeks before Election Day.
Democrats lead Republicans on generic ballot but with more modest advantage compared to 2018, suggesting headwinds despite Trump's collapsing approval ratings.
Data center development emerged as toxic midterm issue with Republican candidates distancing from Trump's pro-data center stance in battleground races.
Democrats mounted competitive campaigns in five states Trump won by double digits in 2024 (Alaska, Iowa, Kansas, Ohio, Texas).
